findings.reason: the attribution clause must carry the passive block's native indefiniteness (or clause (2) must state that the passive sub-block floor stays) or the node repairs the jackets, measures an indefinite joint, and has no cause left in the plan to attribute it to.
findings.text: §7 attributes the indefiniteness to the eight VS3 jackets and requires the repaired build to give "a joint coil-plus-passive linkage that is positive definite for the 12 mm and 6 mm sets, without any floor applied to the joint matrix", but the target is not reachable from that mechanism: the stored `linkage.npy` at the two sectioned-set entries holds the unfloored joint (`build.py` writes `circuit_linkage_matrix`'s raw output; only `system.npz`'s `lmat` is guarded), and its passive sub-block is natively indefinite — 37 negative eigenvalues at 12 mm (minimum −2.5279581e-07 H) and 175 at 6 mm (minimum −9.4509e-08 H) — with no support on the jacket rows: removing rows 608–615, the jacket rows power_convertor's trace identifies, leaves all 37 negative eigenvalues intact (minimum unchanged). The cited record says the same in its own words ("The upstream raw passive block itself has 37 negative eigenvalues"; "Making that passive block positive did not make the joint coil/passive linkage positive"), so the passive block is a third cause that §7's clause (1) never names and clause (2) never measures — a node repairing only the jacket coupling will find the joint still indefinite and be unable to close clause (2)

findings.reason: as written the loader refusal is either vacuous (it refuses everything) or its test proves nothing about the guard, so the plan must state which matrix the refusal is evaluated on — the guarded passive block assembled joint, not the raw `linkage.npy` — or the node ships a guard that refuses the repaired entry itself.
findings.text: §7 requires both "a joint coil-plus-passive linkage that is positive definite" and a test that "copies a pre-repair entry into a scratch cache and asserts the loader refuses it by name", but because every stored entry carries the native passive-block negatives this test would refuse a repaired entry exactly as it refuses a pre-repair one, so it cannot show the new guard fires on stale data rather than on all data, and the section's literal control ("revert the repair, and the Schur complement again has the two negative eigenvalues") measures the coil Schur complement, not the joint linkage the loader check is specified on
